artifacts.description: Merge main into feat/206-model-hash; keep both imports in unpacked.rs

acceptance_criteria: `pub fn sha256(bytes: &[u8]) -> [u8; 32]` in a new module, documented with the FIPS 180-4 citation. No `unsafe`, no new dependencies.

`pub fn model_hash(model: &serde_json::Value) -> String`: `"sha256:"` plus 64 lowercase hex digits of the SHA-256 of exactly the bytes `write_unpacked` writes for `model.json`. The result passes the existing manifest `model_hash` check.

`Document::refresh_model_hash(&mut self)` sets `manifest.model_hash` to `Some(model_hash(&self.model))`. `Document::cache_is_fresh(&self, recorded: &str) -> bool` is true only when `recorded` equals `model_hash(&self.model)`. `write_unpacked` and `write_sltwx` do not change: the golden files are still reproduced byte for byte.

Tests (no `occt`): FIPS 180-4 / NIST example vectors: `""` → `e3b0c44298fc1c149afbf4c8996fb92427ae41e4649b934ca495991b7852b855`; `"abc"` → `ba7816bf8f01cfea414140de5dae2223b00361a396177a9cb410ff61f20015ad`; `"abcdbcdecdefdefgefghfghighijhijkijkljklmklmnlmnomnopnopq"` → `248d6a61d20638b8e5c026930c3e6039a33ce45964ff2167f6ecedd419db06c1`; one million `a` → `cdc76e5c9914fb9281a1c7e284d73e67f1809a48a497200e046d39ccc7112cd0`; padding boundaries: inputs of 55, 56, 63, 64 and 65 bytes of `a` each hash without panic, and every length gives a different digest; the golden `bracket.sltwx` model: `model_hash` equals `"sha256:"` plus the hex `sha256` of the raw bytes of `crates/swx-io/tests/golden/bracket.sltwx/model.json`; after `refresh_model_hash`, `cache_is_fresh` is true for that hash; after changing one value in `model`, it is false; a malformed `recorded` string is false, not a panic.
All existing `swx-io` tests pass unchanged; no test is weakened or removed.
No `unsafe`, and `swx-io` still has no workspace dependencies.
`cargo fmt --all --check && cargo clippy --workspace --all-targets -- -D warnings && cargo test --workspace` pass.
QA report (FACTORY §6b) posted on the PR.
